recipe.visualDefinition: A high-speed racing scene featuring a formula-style car captured with a diagonal motion blur, framed by a thick top header and a vertical side banner containing dense typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the race track creates a dynamic tension against the rigid horizontal header.
The warm, golden-hour lighting on the track contrasts with the cool metallic tones of the car.
The vertical obi strip acts as a structural anchor for the complex typographic elements.
coreInvariants: Motion blur on the track surface
Left-aligned vertical sidebar with contrasting background color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The racing car is positioned in the lower right quadrant, angled diagonally toward the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The driver's white helmet provides a high-contrast focal point amidst the warm tones.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the track's motion blur from bottom-left to top-right, then is caught by the bold top header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark upper-right area provides breathing room for the busy typographic elements on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and amber tones in the track surface and sidebar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark shadows in the upper background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and white on the car and main header text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with deep, crushed blacks for a cinematic 1980s film look.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones, reds, and blacks

characterSpecificRedesigns: Flattened tops and bottoms on rounded characters like O and C

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a dedicated header bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair ultra-wide display headers with vertical columns of dense, medium-weight sans-serif or CJK characters.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem/seal in the bottom left

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the main header
The vertical orientation of the sidebar text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric squareness and width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-speed motion-blurred photograph of a vintage formula race car on a track at sunset. Leave a solid black bar at the top and a tan/gold vertical bar on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-extended red sans-serif text to the top black bar. Add vertical columns of text and a circular logo to the tan sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the top text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is there a clear vertical sidebar on the left?
Does the image feel like a 1980s film photograph?
Is the car positioned on a diagonal?

mustAchieve: Precise geometric alignment of text blocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the motion blur follows a consistent diagonal vector
Verify the sidebar doesn't obscure the main subject
Confirm the color palette remains warm and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Motorsport Photography + Ultra-Extended Geometric Sans + Vertical Obi Strip Layout
